Similarly, gain-of-function variants in APOE disrupt normal lipoprotein metabolism, leading to dyslipoproteinemia, which in turn can promote amyloid deposition and contribute to lipoprotein glomerulopathy. **How to falsify it:** If specific variants in ITM2B known to cause ADan amyloidosis are found at a high frequency (>1%) in population databases like gnomAD, or if variants in APOE associated with lipoprotein glomerulopathy are similarly common, it would challenge the hypothesis that these are rare disease-causing variants. _(variant: rs1042021)_
